## What changed

This release merges 27 upstream commits. Most of the list below is theirs.

- **`lat check` is much faster.** It runs its validators at the same time
  instead of one after another, parses each file once, and reuses that work
  between them. A second run reuses the parse from the first.
- **`lat check --profile` reports where the time went.** Per validator, per
  file, including whether the parser had to load at all.
- **`lat check --fix` still works, and now runs before the rest.** It rewrites
  index files, and the other checks read those same files, so it has to finish
  first.
- **Wiki links can point at any file or directory in the repository.**
  `[[schema.sql]]` and `[[src/components]]` now validate.
- **You can pin files from other Git repositories.** A `[[ref]]` can resolve
  into a repository that is not part of your project.
- **Java and Dart source files are supported** for `@lat:` comments and
  `[[src/File.java#Symbol]]` links.
- **Search can show its scores.** Use `--debug` to see why a result ranked
  where it did, and set a relevance threshold to drop weak matches.
- **The Stop hook counts untracked files.** A freshly created `lat.md/` that
  has never been committed now registers as updated.
- **The local browser can edit Markdown**, renders GitHub Markdown extensions,
  and serves documents from URLs without a `.md` suffix.

Fixed in the fork:

- **`lat:ignore` works again when ripgrep is not installed.** The two scan
  paths had drifted apart, so a line marked `lat:ignore` was still counted as a
  reference on machines without `rg`. Both paths now apply the same rules.

## Known issue

- **A document with a very long unbroken paragraph is slow to parse.** The new
  Markdown extensions scan superlinearly inside a single paragraph, so cost
  grows much faster than size: about 3s for 180 KB with no blank line in it,
  and about 35s for 700 KB. Blank lines between paragraphs avoid it entirely —
  the same 1.8 MB takes 1.3s split into paragraphs and 46s as one. Ordinary
  prose is unaffected. This comes from upstream.

## Upgrading

```
npm i -g --prefix ~/.local/lat https://github.com/PlebeianTech/lat.md/releases/latest/download/lat.md-latest.tgz
```
